newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN NEUHAUS IPO PRICED AT 1,750 BFR A SHARE.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN NEUHAUS IPO PRICED AT 1,750 BFR A SHARE.

text.p: Shares in an initial public offering (IPO) by Belgian chocolates maker Neuhaus have been priced at 1,750 Belgian francs each, lead manager Petercam said in a statement on Wednesday.
The IPO consisted of a combined offer of 450,000 ordinary shares, with 750,000 Neuhaus shares to be listed on the Brussels stock exchange.
Petercam said that after a clawback exercise, 40 percent of the combined offer went to private investors and 60 percent to institutionals.

The IPO was closed early on Tuesday after the offer was 15 times oversubscribed. The shares will begin trading on the bourse on March 4, earlier than the March 10 date originally planned. March 4 is also payment date for the offer.
Petercam said a green shoe of 45,000 shares could be used once the shares are quoted on the bourse.
